macos.notes: Four sources in this fixed order, re-read on every fetch. 1) Claude Code: $.env.ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN or $.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, accepted only when $.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL's host is api.z.ai, *.z.ai, open.bigmodel.cn or *.bigmodel.cn; otherwise it is an Anthropic key. 2) ZCode plan key: $.provider[*] whose key contains 'coding-plan', not enabled:false, with options.apiKey; console from options.baseURL's host. 3) ZCode OAuth: $['oauth:zai:access_token'], skipped when it starts with 'enc:v1:'. 4) OpenCode: ids zai-coding-plan, zai, z-ai, z.ai, zhipu, zhipuai; string or object with apiKey|api_key|token|key|accessToken|auth_token; zhipu* → open.bigmodel.cn. Only the console host survives: https://api.z.ai or https://open.bigmodel.cn.

windows.path: same four files under the user profile

endpoints.name: quotaLimit
endpoints.notes: The token goes raw: prefixing Bearer is exactly what an auth failure looks like from here.

response.envelopeErrors: Under HTTP 200: success == true || code absent || code == 200 means success; otherwise code 401/403 → needsAuth, 429 → rateLimited, any other code → badResponse(code). Example recorded verbatim: {"code":401,"msg":"token expired or incorrect","success":false}.

windows.label: Current session
windows.notes: Identity comes from (unit, number), never from type: TOKENS_LIMIT and CREDIT_LIMIT encode the same windows. Percentages above 100 are kept. A limit without percentage is dropped; a window without reset is kept.

status.notice: Plan level comes back as $.data.level (pro, lite…) for the account row.
